title.zh: 将卡加延谷区域医院改设为医疗中心，名称为卡加延谷医疗中心，并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Cagayan Valley Regional Hospital Into a Medical Center to Be Known as the Cagayan Valley Medical Center, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Cagayan Valley Regional Hospital Into a Medical Center to Be Known as the Cagayan Valley Medical Center, and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Bệnh viện Vùng Cagayan Valley thành Trung tâm Y tế với tên gọi Cagayan Valley Medical Center, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะโรงพยาบาลภูมิภาค Cagayan Valley เป็น ศูนย์การแพทย์ ในชื่อ Cagayan Valley Medical Center และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Rumah Sakit Regional Cagayan Valley menjadi Pusat Medis dengan nama Cagayan Valley Medical Center, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Hospital Wilayah Cagayan Valley kepada Pusat Perubatan dengan nama Cagayan Valley Medical Center, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1998/ra_8599_1998.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Cagayan Valley Regional Hospital in the Municipality of Tuguegarao, Cagayan (Region II) is hereby converted into a medical center to be renamed as Cagayan Valley Medical Center, hereinafter referred to as the Center, and increasing its bed capacity to five hundred (500).
The Department of Health shall promulgate the rules and regulations necessary for the effective implementation of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
